metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent used VS Code Find & Replace (Ctrl+H) to replace all 'text'→'test' (10 occurrences), saved with Ctrl+S.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can use VS Code Find & Replace for global substitution; save files with keyboard shortcuts.
metadata.task_rationale: Hardest variation: requires three sequential Find & Replace operations. Chains text→test (10 occurrences), educational→academic (2), and curriculum→program (2). Partial credit (0.33/0.34/0.33) rewards completing each sub-goal.
metadata.explanation: Evaluator reads the file and checks three independent replacements with partial credit: (1) 'text' absent + 'test' >=10 times (+0.33); (2) 'educational' absent + 'academic' >=2 times (+0.34); (3) 'curriculum' absent + 'program' >=2 times (+0.33). All checks fail in initial state. [Fixed: renamed getter/metric functions from invalid 8-char suffix '170ab981' to correct 32-char MD5 hash '076bfd2d3ed2cd7e42a937a1dd80c8a9' computed from '0ed39f63-6049-43d4-ba4d-5fa2fe04a951|4']

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the saved file from /home/user/Desktop/vscode_replace_text.txt via env.controller.get_file() and decodes UTF-8, returning {'content': ...}.
Postconfig executes ctrl+s before evaluation, ensuring the file on disk reflects the agent's edits.
Metric checks all three required replacements as specified in the instruction: 'text'→'test', 'educational'→'academic', 'curriculum'→'program'.

Each sub-goal uses both a forbidden-absence check (old word must not appear) and a required-presence check (new word must appear at least N times), correctly distinguishing full replacement from partial or no replacement.
Partial credit (0.33/0.34/0.33) rewards each independently completed sub-goal, matching the multi-objective instruction.
min_count thresholds (10, 2, 2) are calibrated to the original file's word frequencies, confirmed by trajectory evidence showing exactly 10 occurrences of 'text'.
'text' is not a substring of 'test' (t-e-x-t vs t-e-s-t), so the forbidden check correctly validates full replacement without false negatives.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: if the original file contains compound words with 'text' as a substring (e.g., 'textbook'), the forbidden check would still fail after a whole-word-only replacement. Consider verifying the source file has no such compounds, or document this assumption.
